(2) A close-up shot focuses on the patient's cheek where the silver mechanical gun is being applied. The medical assistants wear white gloves and maintain steady hands. The lighting is focused and bright on the surgical area with green drapes visible. (3) The woman, now wearing a pink hair cap, speaks directly to the camera. She uses expansive hand gestures to demonstrate volume and size while the assistants continue the procedure in the background. (4) A macro shot shows the tip of the needle releasing a single, tiny yellow droplet of fat onto a green cloth, illustrating precision. (5) The woman continues explaining, moving her hands to show 'swelling' and then 'shrinking' motions. She touches her neck and jawline while looking towards the camera with a professional expression.
